answer: Key-linking to one vault collapses sybil farms. Every wallet registers an identity-link transaction binding its key to an AgentConnect vault, and a vault counts as one entity: one seat, one weighted vote, one payout line, however many keys hang beneath it. A trellis of clones sharing one operator merges into a single voice with pooled, halved rewards. Escaping the link means distinct custody and funding for every fake, and identities sharing a funding source are slashed together like saffron threads from one bulb. Voting power follows the spiral of custody, not key count.
